'''Khiss''' was a hulking [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] and friend of [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]].<ref name="The Hunt For Anakin Skywalker">''[[Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker]]''</ref>

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Khiss assisted [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] in the hunting of several [[Ghostling]] children who had escaped [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]]. Along with [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]] and [[Gondry]], he tracked the children and their slave helpers to Gardulla's pleasure gardens.<ref name="The Hunt For Anakin Skywalker" />

[[Pala Kwi'teksa|Pala]] distracted the Dug into chasing her through the garden, and she narrowly avoided the snare of a carnivorous [[Deneba bush]]. Unfortunately, Khiss did not notice the danger until it was too late, and was eaten whole by the bush before he could so much as scream.<ref name="Episode I Adventures: Capture Arawynne">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>
